def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    items = db['order_items']
    orders = db['orders']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

        'num_orders', 'num_items', 'sum_price', 'sum_sales', 'mean_price',
        'std_price', 'min_price', 'max_price', 'sum_freight', 'mean_freight',
        'mean_delivery_days', 'avg_review_score', 'count_reviews',
        'positive_review_ratio', 'avg_installments', 'avg_payment_value',
        'credit_card_ratio', 'recency', 'sales_30', 'sales_90',
        'sales_180', 'sales_365', 'trend_30_90', 'mean_delivery_delay',
        'canceled_ratio', 'delivered_ratio'
    ]

    # Purchases strictly before seed_time
    hist_mask = items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)
    hist_items = items[hist_mask].copy()

    if hist_items.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=feature_columns, index=entity_ids, dtype=float)

    order_ids = hist_items['order_id'].unique()

    # --- Orders: only info known at seed_time ---
    orders_sub = orders[orders['order_id'].isin(order_ids)].copy()
    # purchase must be before seed_time (implied by items filter, but keep safe)
    orders_sub = orders_sub[orders_sub['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    # delivery time only if delivered before seed_time
    delivered_mask = (
        orders_sub['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()
        & (orders_sub['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    )
    orders_sub['delivery_time_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (orders_sub['order_delivered_customer_date'] - orders_sub['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    # delivery delay vs estimate, only for delivered orders
    orders_sub['delivery_delay'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & orders_sub['order_estimated_delivery_date'].notna(),
        (orders_sub['order_delivered_customer_date'] - orders_sub['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    # status known at seed_time
    orders_sub['is_canceled'] = (
        orders_sub['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])
        & (orders_sub['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time)
    ).astype(float)
    orders_sub['is_delivered'] = delivered_mask.astype(float)

        reviews['order_id'].isin(order_ids)
        & (reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time)
    ]

        review_agg = reviews_sub.groupby('order_id').agg(
            review_count=('review_score', 'count'),
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            positive_review_ratio=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).mean())
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        review_agg = pd.DataFrame({
            'order_id': pd.Series(dtype=object),
            'review_count': pd.Series(dtype=float),
            'avg_review_score': pd.Series(dtype=float),
            'positive_review_ratio': pd.Series(dtype=float)
        })

    # --- Payments: only payments recorded before seed_time ---
    if 'ts' in payments.columns:
        pay_mask = payments['order_id'].isin(order_ids) & (payments['ts'] < seed_time)
    else:
        pay_mask = payments['order_id'].isin(order_ids)

        payment_agg = payments_sub.groupby('order_id').agg(
            sum_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            mean_payment=('payment_value', 'mean'),
            avg_inst=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            credit_ratio=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').mean())
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        payment_agg = pd.DataFrame({

            'mean_payment': pd.Series(dtype=float),
            'avg_inst': pd.Series(dtype=float),
            'credit_ratio': pd.Series(dtype=float)
        })

    orders_agg = orders_sub.merge(review_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    orders_agg = orders_agg.merge(payment_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    hist_items = hist_items.merge(orders_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

        sales_180=('age', lambda x: _cnt_le(x, 180)),
        sales_365=('age', lambda x: _cnt_le(x, 365))
    ).reset_index()
